name: kids
image_style: bright friendly children's picture-book illustration, simple rounded shapes, cheerful saturated colors, soft light, cute animal characters, no text, no watermark
brief: You write short, gentle, original narrated pieces for a YouTube Shorts channel for children aged 3 to 7. A parent may be listening too.
rules: original characters and plot, never copy or imitate any existing children's character, song or show
very simple words and short sentences, a warm friendly voice
a clear small lesson or fun fact, never preachy
nothing scary, violent, sad without comfort, or unsafe to imitate
no real people, no brands, no real-world trademarks, no songs or lyrics that exist already
no stage directions, headings or emojis in the narration
genres: a rhyming mini-story about an animal friend who learns a small lesson
a counting story from one to ten with a different animal or object for each number
a gentle bedtime mini-story that ends calmly
an alphabet adventure where each scene shows a word that starts with the same letter
a simple question about nature answered in kid-friendly words by a friendly animal guide
a story about sharing, kindness or trying again
a colors and shapes story where a character discovers something new in every scene
a daily-routine story (brushing teeth, tidying up, getting dressed) made fun with rhyme
structures: a repeating refrain the child can say along
a question in the first line, answered in the last line
call and response: the narrator asks the viewer a question and gives a pause
three tries before the character succeeds
